steps.title: Project Setup
steps.description: Establish application base folders, configure package namespace com.voiceassistantai.app and load settings.

steps.title: Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with Internet and Record Audio permissions, plus required query tags for offline Speech Recognition service.

steps.title: Gradle Configuration
steps.description: Configure compileSdk 34, minSdk 21, and application options targeting Java 8 in build.gradle.

steps.title: Define Colors and Resources
steps.description: Setup app visual palette containing deep teals, active reds, and soft bubble shades.

steps.title: Implement Vector Icons
steps.description: Create scalable UI vectors for mic controls, settings, and playback cancellation actions.

steps.title: Draw UI Bubble Assets
steps.description: Construct modern chat bubbles and active/idle state shapes for the recording controller.

steps.title: Design Custom Soundwave Visualizer
steps.description: Write WaveformView.java to calculate dynamic RMS amplitudes and draw real-time sine waves while speaking.

steps.title: Build Activity Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml consisting of conversation log panels, status indicator boards, dynamic wave views, and control buttons.

steps.title: Build Conversation Layout Templates
steps.description: Design custom templates for dynamically inflating assistant responses and user prompt elements into the scroll framework.

steps.title: Setup Settings Dialog Configuration
steps.description: Build dynamic API key inputs, detailed role inputs, and model selectors allowing preset selections or custom inputs.

steps.title: Code Core App Brain Logics
steps.description: Program MainActivity.java to bind SpeechRecognizer, TextToSpeech engine, preferences storage, and non-blocking background thread API requests.

steps.title: Building Voice Assistant AI
steps.description: Assemble complete resources and execute internal compiling sequence using standard Java gradle build tasks.
